entities.name: Oral Traditions as Historical Evidence
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The transmission of cultural knowledge, histories, laws, and identities through spoken word across generations. Before writing, all human knowledge was oral. Even after literacy, oral traditions — griots in West Africa, Aboriginal Dreamtime narratives, Polynesian genealogies — preserved histories spanning thousands of years with remarkable accuracy, now recognized as valid historical evidence.
